name: prompt-best-practices
description: Interactive prompt structuring skill using a 7-component framework derived from Anthropic's published prompting guide. Tier-adaptive dialogue, deterministic component rubric, and activation-regression fixtures.

interface.shortDescription: Structure the prompt before executing it
interface.longDescription: Assess a request against 7 components (Task, Role, Context, Examples, Output specification, Constraints, Structure), size the dialogue to the task tier, then build the smallest sufficient prompt.
